plan.title: RFQ Counter Offer Hidden When Setting Is On

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ Responses screen with Vendor A's bid.
Enable eRFX projects for the prepared RFQ scenario.
Enable the company setting that should hide Counter Offer on RFQ rounds.
Apply the case's required bidding-time rejection configuration.
Apply the case's required buyer bid-editing configuration.
Apply the case's required counter-offer percentage configuration.
Verify that Counter Offer is not offered on the RFQ Responses screen.
